artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan porting git-commit-phase.sh's deployed-tree containment strip into git-commit-scoped.sh's V10 resolution block (Site 3), with a new Z19 regression case, Case 26's restored end-to-end assertion, and the git-staging-scope.md residual closure.

memory_candidates.content: A plan phase whose only deliverable is a markdown doc under the agent-system source store (e.g. context/standards/*.md) is NOT automatically a `prose` tier phase: suite_selection_select can map such a doc to real shell suites (git-staging-scope.md maps to test-git-commit-phase.sh and test-todo-move-pair-staging.sh), because suites assert against the standard's own content. Run the selector before declaring `prose`; when it returns real suite basenames rather than __FULL_SWEEP__, `local` with a verify-touched.sh justification is the honest cheapest tier, since `prose`'s diff read-through does not exercise those assertions.
